title: Decision Making and Ride Comfort Evaluation Based on Lane-Change Prediction for Autonomous Vehicles
abstract: arXiv:2610.30528v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Predicting surrounding vehicles' lane-change intentions enables autonomous vehicles to anticipate potential hazards and respond proactively rather than relying solely on reactive maneuvers. This study investigates the benefits of integrating lane-change prediction, based on knowledge graph embeddings and Bayesian inference, into autonomous vehicle decision-making. Three driving strategies are evaluated in risky merging scenarios simulated in CARLA: reactive driving, prediction-based longitudinal action, and prediction-based lateral action. The proposed prediction model anticipates the surrounding vehicle's lane change approximately 3-4 seconds before its occurrence, allowing the ego vehicle to adjust its behavior accordingly. In the representative simulation records, reactive driving results in a collision accompanied by aggressive deceleration. translated_title: 基于换道预测的自动驾驶车辆决策制定与乘坐舒适性评估
translated_abstract: 预测周围车辆的换道意图能够使自动驾驶车辆预判潜在危险并采取主动响应，而非仅仅依赖被动反应式操作。本研究探讨了将基于知识图谱嵌入和贝叶斯推断的换道预测集成到自动驾驶车辆决策制定中的益处。在CARLA仿真平台构建的危险汇入场景中，研究评估了三种驾驶策略：反应式驾驶、基于预测的纵向动作以及基于预测的横向动作。所提出的预测模型能够在周围车辆实际换道发生前约3-4秒预判其行为，从而使本车能够相应地调整自身行为。在代表性仿真记录中，反应式驾驶导致碰撞并伴随剧烈减速。相比之下，基于预测的纵向动作通过提前制动建立起安全的（原文在此处截断）
tldr: 本研究提出将基于知识图谱嵌入和贝叶斯推断的换道预测方法集成到自动驾驶决策中，可提前3-4秒预判周围车辆的换道行为，相比反应式驾驶策略有效避免了碰撞并改善了乘坐舒适性。
en_tdlr: This study integrates lane-change prediction based on knowledge graph embeddings and Bayesian inference into autonomous vehicle decision-making, enabling anticipation of surrounding vehicles' lane changes 3-4 seconds in advance, which effectively avoids collisions and improves ride comfort compared to reactive driving strategies.
